title: 離子束光學表面修形
summary: 從氬離子濺射的原子級去除出發，建立高斯去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與空間頻率上限的概念，再把離子源、柵極、真空與基板熱負載、干涉量測對位、誤差預算與驗收紀錄串成一條可重複的確定性修形流程。
summaryEn: Starting from atomic-scale removal by argon-ion sputtering, build the Gaussian removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and spatial-frequency limit, then chain ion source, grids, vacuum, substrate thermal load, interferometer registration, error budget and acceptance record into a repeatable deterministic figuring process.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濺射去除的物理與去除率」與「去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" and "Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氬離子束與工件表面」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。每個入射離子平均濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，對熔融石英在 1 keV 附近約為 1 個原子，去除深度只由離子通量、產率與材料原子密度決定。因為沒有機械接觸，不存在拋光壓力造成的邊緣效應與工具磨耗，整個過程在真空中進行，去除量以奈米為單位可預測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氬離子束與工件表面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV; each ion transfers momentum to near-surface atoms, starting a collision cascade in which some atoms gain enough energy to leave the surface. The mean number of atoms ejected per incident ion is the sputter yield Y, about 1 atom per ion for fused silica near 1 keV, so removal depth is set only by ion flux, yield and atomic density. With no mechanical contact there is no pressure-driven edge effect and no tool wear; the process runs in vacuum and removal is predictable in nanometres. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氬離子束與工件表面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The mean number of atoms ejected per incident ion is the sputter yield Y, about 1 atom per ion for fused silica near 1 keV, so removal depth is set only by ion flux, yield and atomic density.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「離子束光學表面修形」的「濺射去除的物理與去除率：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Sputter removal physics and removal rate: mechanism and system boundary” in “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「濺射去除的物理與去除率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" is correct?
options: 離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。
離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。
只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。
optionsEn: An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel.
Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV.
Given enough dwell time an ion beam can correct errors of any spatial frequency.
quiz.explanation: 離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV; each ion transfers momentum to near-surface atoms, starting a collision cascade in which some atoms gain enough energy to leave the surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氬離子束與工件表面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。熔融石英 n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² 原子/cm³；取 Y = 1.0、j = 1 mA/cm²，離子通量 j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ 離子/(cm²·s)，ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s，約 56 nm/min；產率隨入射角在 60° 到 70° 附近達到最大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. For fused silica n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² atoms/cm³; with Y = 1.0 and j = 1 mA/cm² the ion flux j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ ions/(cm²·s) gives ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s, about 56 nm/min; the yield peaks near 60° to 70° incidence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。熔融石英 n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² 原子/cm³；取 Y = 1.0、j = 1 mA/cm²，離子通量 j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ 離子/(cm²·s)，ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s，約 56 nm/min；產率隨入射角在 60° 到 70° 附近達到最大。
knowledge.textEn: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. For fused silica n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² atoms/cm³; with Y = 1.0 and j = 1 mA/cm² the ion flux j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ ions/(cm²·s) gives ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s, about 56 nm/min; the yield peaks near 60° to 70° incidence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「濺射去除的物理與去除率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sputter removal physics and removal rate", which statement holds?
options: 離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。
多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。
去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。
optionsEn: Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored.
With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero.
Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density.
quiz.explanation: 去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氬離子束與工件表面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把從熔融石英量到的去除率直接套到碳化矽或微晶玻璃，產率差異會讓實際去除量與駐留時間圖不符，修形後面形不但沒有收斂反而出現與誤差圖同形的殘差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying a removal rate measured on fused silica to silicon carbide or glass ceramic lets the yield difference desynchronise actual removal from the dwell map; the figure fails to converge and leaves a residual shaped like the original error map.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濺射去除的物理與去除率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sputter removal physics and removal rate"?
options: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
離子束可以直接修正任何粗拋後的表面，前段拋光品質不重要。
optionsEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氬離子束與工件表面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把從熔融石英量到的去除率直接套到碳化矽或微晶玻璃，產率差異會讓實際去除量與駐留時間圖不符，修形後面形不但沒有收斂反而出現與誤差圖同形的殘差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Applying a removal rate measured on fused silica to silicon carbide or glass ceramic lets the yield difference desynchronise actual removal from the dwell map; the figure fails to converge and leaves a residual shaped like the original error map. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為沒有機械接觸，不存在拋光壓力造成的邊緣效應與工具磨耗，整個過程在真空中進行，去除量以奈米為單位可預測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With no mechanical contact there is no pressure-driven edge effect and no tool wear; the process runs in vacuum and removal is predictable in nanometres.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束在工件上的去除分佈稱為去除函數（beam removal function），通常近似高斯，半高全寬由柵極光學與工作距離決定，約 3 到 30 mm。修形時束流以固定功率在面上掃描，實際去除量等於去除函數與駐留時間圖的二維卷積，因此已知誤差圖後必須反卷積求出非負的駐留時間，常用 Richardson–Lucy 或帶非負約束的最小平方法。高斯函數在頻域也是高斯，空間週期短於束寬的誤差幾乎無法被修正，這決定了離子束修形只能處理低頻面形，中高頻必須由前段拋光控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The removal distribution of the beam on the workpiece is the beam removal function, usually near Gaussian with a full width at half maximum set by grid optics and working distance, about 3 to 30 mm. During figuring the beam scans the surface at constant power, and actual removal equals the two-dimensional convolution of the removal function with the dwell-time map, so the error map must be deconvolved into a non-negative dwell map with Richardson–Lucy or non-negative least squares. A Gaussian is also Gaussian in the frequency domain, so errors with periods shorter than the beam width are barely correctable; ion-beam figuring therefore handles low-frequency figure only, and mid and high frequencies must be controlled by the preceding polish. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：去除函數 R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²)，σ = FWHM/2.355；FWHM = 10 mm 時 σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Removal function R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²) with σ = FWHM/2.355; for FWHM = 10 mm, σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Given enough dwell time an ion beam can correct errors of any spatial frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：去除函數 R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²)，σ = FWHM/2.355；FWHM = 10 mm 時 σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s。其頻率響應 H(f) = exp(−2π²σ²f²)：週期等於 FWHM（f = 0.1 mm⁻¹）時 H ≈ 0.028，週期 20 mm 時 H ≈ 0.41，週期 40 mm 時 H ≈ 0.80，所以可修正週期約需大於 3 倍束寬。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Removal function R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²) with σ = FWHM/2.355; for FWHM = 10 mm, σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s. Its frequency response H(f) = exp(−2π²σ²f²) gives H ≈ 0.028 for a period equal to the FWHM (f = 0.1 mm⁻¹), H ≈ 0.41 at a 20 mm period and H ≈ 0.80 at 40 mm, so correctable periods need to exceed roughly 3 beam widths. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把量到的誤差圖做功率譜密度分析，用 H(f) 預測每個頻段修形後的殘餘量，再與實際修形後的 PSD 比較；同時用去除函數與駐留時間圖重新卷積，確認模擬去除量與干涉儀量到的前後差異在幾個奈米內一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the power spectral density of the measured error map, predict the post-figuring residual per band with H(f), and compare with the PSD measured after the run; also re-convolve the removal function with the dwell map and confirm that the simulated removal matches the interferometric before-and-after difference within a few nanometres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把量到的誤差圖做功率譜密度分析，用 H(f) 預測每個頻段修形後的殘餘量，再與實際修形後的 PSD 比較；同時用去除函數與駐留時間圖重新卷積，確認模擬去除量與干涉儀量到的前後差異在幾個奈米內一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the power spectral density of the measured error map, predict the post-figuring residual per band with H(f), and compare with the PSD measured after the run; also re-convolve the removal function with the dwell map and confirm that the simulated removal matches the interferometric before-and-after difference within a few nanometres. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差；若誤差圖含低於束寬的波紋，反卷積會放大雜訊造成駐留時間圖劇烈震盪。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without a non-negativity constraint the deconvolution asks for material to be added at some points; those negative dwells are clipped to zero and ring-shaped residuals remain around the peaks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差；若誤差圖含低於束寬的波紋，反卷積會放大雜訊造成駐留時間圖劇烈震盪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Gaussian is also Gaussian in the frequency domain, so errors with periods shorter than the beam width are barely correctable; ion-beam figuring therefore handles low-frequency figure only, and mid and high frequencies must be controlled by the preceding polish.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Given enough dwell time an ion beam can correct errors of any spatial frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差；若誤差圖含低於束寬的波紋，反卷積會放大雜訊造成駐留時間圖劇烈震盪。
knowledge.textEn: Without a non-negativity constraint the deconvolution asks for material to be added at some points; those negative dwells are clipped to zero and ring-shaped residuals remain around the peaks. If the error map contains ripple below the beam width, the deconvolution amplifies noise into a violently oscillating dwell map.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
提高柵極電壓就能無限制地提高束流密度與去除率。
若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Raising grid voltage increases beam current density and removal rate without limit.
Without a non-negativity constraint the deconvolution asks for material to be added at some points.
quiz.explanation: 若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差；若誤差圖含低於束寬的波紋，反卷積會放大雜訊造成駐留時間圖劇烈震盪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a non-negativity constraint the deconvolution asks for material to be added at some points; those negative dwells are clipped to zero and ring-shaped residuals remain around the peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
